$comment: Public-primitive manifest. Source of truth for EXT.Contracts.md. Edit here, then run python -m serverframework.extensions.build_contracts_md.

entries.name: BaseExternalError
entries.summary: Base class for every error a *_via_provider call may raise.
invariants: Carries provider, ability, and original cause.
Subclasses are caught by RotationManager to drive failover.

entries.name: TransientExternalError
entries.summary: Retryable network or 5xx failure; the rotation policy applies exponential backoff.
invariants: Retry budget is bounded by RotationPolicy.transient_max_retries.

entries.name: RateLimitExternalError
entries.summary: Provider returned 429 or a documented rate-limit signal.
invariants: Carries retry_after_seconds when the provider supplies it.
RotationManager honours retry_after_seconds before next attempt.

entries.name: AuthExternalError
entries.summary: Credentials rejected; the provider instance is cooled down.
invariants: Triggers RotationPolicy.auth_cooldown_seconds on the offending instance.

entries.name: InvalidInputExternalError
entries.summary: 4xx caused by caller input; never retried.
invariants: RotationManager surfaces the error to the caller without failover.

entries.name: PermanentExternalError
entries.summary: Non-retryable provider failure (e.g., feature disabled).
invariants: Counts as a hard failure for the rotation chain.

entries.name: RotationPolicy
entries.summary: Per-provider retry, backoff, and cooldown configuration.
invariants: All retry budgets are non-negative.
header_parser is a callable returning Optional[int] seconds.

entries.name: DegradationPolicy
entries.summary: Behaviour when the rotation chain is exhausted.
invariants: outbox_retention_days and outbox_max_attempts are non-negative.

entries.name: DegradationMode
entries.summary: Enum of FAIL_FAST, QUEUE_AND_RETRY, SILENT_DROP.

entries.name: RetentionPolicy
entries.summary: Window-and-archive policy attached to retention-eligible models.
invariants: window suffix is one of s/m/h/d/w/mo/y or literal 'forever'.
legal_hold suspends purges for matching rows.

entries.name: CostModel
entries.summary: Protocol mapping (request, response) to a Decimal cost.
invariants: Implementations are pure: no I/O, no state mutation.

entries.name: ConstantCostModel
entries.summary: Fixed cost per call regardless of payload.

entries.name: TokenBasedCostModel
entries.summary: Cost computed from input/output token counts.

entries.name: PercentOfAmountCostModel
entries.summary: Cost as a percentage of a monetary amount on the request.

entries.name: FreeCostModel
entries.summary: Always-zero cost; the canonical no-op model.

entries.name: TenantCostCap
entries.summary: Per-tenant maximum cost over a window; rejects calls past the cap.

entries.name: AuthStrategy
entries.summary: ABC for outbound credential strategies attached to provider instances.
invariants: headers_for, params_for, body_modifier never raise on well-formed requesters.
refresh_if_needed is idempotent.

entries.name: APIKeyAuth
entries.summary: Header- or query-based API-key strategy.

entries.name: OAuth2Auth
entries.summary: OAuth2 access-token strategy with refresh.

entries.name: JWTBearerAuth
entries.summary: Static or signed JWT bearer-token strategy.

entries.name: BasicAuth
entries.summary: HTTP Basic auth from username/password credentials.

entries.name: MTLSAuth
entries.summary: Mutual-TLS strategy that injects the client cert/key.

entries.name: AWSSigV4Auth
entries.summary: AWS Signature V4 request signer.

entries.name: AuthStrategyRegistry
entries.summary: Registry mapping strategy names to AuthStrategy classes.

entries.name: FieldMapping
entries.summary: ABC for declarative external-field translations.

entries.name: Rename
entries.summary: 1:1 rename between local and external fields.

entries.name: Compose
entries.summary: Combine multiple local fields into one external field.

entries.name: Decompose
entries.summary: Split one external field across multiple local fields.

entries.name: DotPath
entries.summary: Dotted-path projection into nested external payloads.

entries.name: UnitConvert
entries.summary: Numerical unit conversion (e.g., cents/dollars).

entries.name: EnumRemap
entries.summary: Bidirectional remap between local and external enum values.

entries.name: TimestampConvert
entries.summary: Convert between epoch/ISO/datetime representations.

entries.name: Custom
entries.summary: Escape hatch for arbitrary callable mappings.

entries.name: AbstractPaginator
entries.summary: ABC for external-list pagination strategies.

entries.name: OffsetPaginator
entries.summary: Offset/limit pagination.

entries.name: CursorPaginator
entries.summary: Opaque-cursor pagination.

entries.name: PageTokenPaginator
entries.summary: next_page_token pagination.

entries.name: LinkHeaderPaginator
entries.summary: RFC 5988 Link-header pagination.

entries.name: AbstractQueryDSLTranslator
entries.summary: ABC translating local search models to provider DSLs.

entries.name: StripeSearchTranslator
entries.summary: Translator for Stripe's search-query syntax.

entries.name: SOQLTranslator
entries.summary: Translator for Salesforce SOQL.

entries.name: GraphQLFilterTranslator
entries.summary: Translator for GraphQL `where`-style filters.

entries.name: MongoStyleTranslator
entries.summary: Translator for Mongo-style operator filters.

entries.name: KeyValueTranslator
entries.summary: Translator for flat key=value query strings.

entries.name: AbstractStaticProvider
entries.summary: Base class for every provider declared by an extension.
invariants: Subclasses define abilities via @ability methods.
_instance is the bonded AbstractProviderInstance, or None.

entries.name: AbstractStaticExtension
entries.summary: Base class for an extension's static surface (providers, models, hooks).

entries.name: AbstractProviderInstance
entries.summary: Bonded credential-bearing runtime instance for a provider.
invariants: validate_credentials returns True only when the instance can serve calls.
close releases all held resources.

entries.name: ability
entries.summary: Marks a provider method as a callable ability.
invariants: Decorated methods receive the bonded instance as self.

entries.name: extension_model
entries.summary: Injects extension-declared fields into a core ApplicationModel.
invariants: Field-name collisions are detected at install time.

entries.name: webhook_handler
entries.summary: Registers a static method as a webhook handler at /webhook/{ext}/{provider}/{event}.

entries.name: WebhookContext
entries.summary: Verified-payload context delivered to webhook handlers.

entries.name: custom_route
entries.summary: Declares a non-CRUD REST/GraphQL/SDK route on a RouterMixin manager.

entries.name: CustomRouteSpec
entries.summary: Frozen specification produced by @custom_route.

entries.name: ExposeIn
entries.summary: Enum of REST/GRAPHQL/SDK exposure targets.

entries.name: RouterMixin
entries.summary: Mixin that turns a BLL manager into a FastAPI router source.

entries.name: AbstractBLLManager
entries.summary: Base class for every BLL manager.
invariants: Constructor signature is (model_registry, requester_id, ...).
All mutating methods participate in the hook system.

entries.name: ApplicationModel
entries.summary: Canonical Pydantic+SQLAlchemy base for persisted entities.

entries.name: hook_bll
entries.summary: Registers a function as a BEFORE/AFTER hook on a BLL method.
invariants: BEFORE hooks default to blocking=True; AFTER to blocking=False.

entries.name: HookContext
entries.summary: Generic over (P, R) — the target's ParamSpec and return type.

entries.name: AbstractService
entries.summary: Base lifecycle for long-lived services (start/stop/pause/resume/health).

entries.name: PerpetualService
entries.summary: Service that runs continuously until stopped.

entries.name: ScheduledService
entries.summary: Service driven by a cron-like schedule.

entries.name: QueueConsumerService
entries.summary: Service that drains a job queue.

entries.name: StreamingService
entries.summary: Service consuming or producing a continuous stream.

entries.name: RotationManager
entries.summary: Failover-only rotation across a linear chain of provider instances.
invariants: Constructor is (model_registry, requester_id, ...).
rotate consumes the calling provider's RotationPolicy.

entries.name: ProviderInstanceModel
entries.summary: Persisted credential-and-configuration record for a bonded provider.

entries.name: OneTimeTokenMixin
entries.summary: Reusable mixin for hashed, salted, expiring single-use codes.
invariants: verify rejects expired or already-used codes.
mark_used is idempotent.

entries.name: PasswordlessGrantRegistry
entries.summary: Registry of (grant_type, validator) pairs for UserManager.login_via_grant.

entries.name: SessionModel
entries.summary: Persisted authenticated session with freshness and scope.

entries.name: UserModel
entries.summary: Canonical user record (extension-injectable via @extension_model).

entries.name: UserManager
entries.summary: BLL manager for user creation, login, grants, and erasure.

entries.name: Quota
entries.summary: Unified per-user / per-team / per-user-within-team quota record.

entries.name: RetentionService
entries.summary: Sweeps RetentionPolicy-bearing models and archives or purges expired rows.

entries.name: FieldCollisionError
entries.summary: Raised when two extensions inject incompatible fields onto the same model.

entries.name: register_extension_field
entries.summary: Records an extension-declared field for collision auditing.

entries.name: detect_extension_field_collisions
entries.summary: Returns the set of conflicting (model, field) pairs across registered extensions.

entries.name: MirrorPolicy
entries.summary: Enum selecting create/update/delete propagation behaviour.

entries.name: MirrorEvent
entries.summary: Enum of mirrored lifecycle events.

entries.name: MirrorSpec
entries.summary: Frozen spec produced by @mirror_on_* decorators.

entries.name: env_is_table_owned_by_extension
entries.summary: Reports the owning extension for a SQLAlchemy table, or None for core.

entries.name: list_table_ownership
entries.summary: Maps every table in metadata to its owning extension (or None).

entries.name: ResidencyJurisdiction
entries.summary: Typed jurisdiction marker (e.g., EU, US, IN).

entries.name: ResidencyRegion
entries.summary: Typed deployment-region marker resolved from a jurisdiction.

entries.name: JurisdictionRegistry
entries.summary: Registry mapping jurisdictions to permitted regions.

entries.name: RateLimit
entries.summary: Configuration record: rps and burst.

entries.name: TokenBucket
entries.summary: Token-bucket primitive used by RateLimit enforcement.

entries.name: ConcurrencyLimit
entries.summary: Bounded-concurrency primitive complementing RateLimit.

entries.name: OutboxEntry
entries.summary: Persisted unit of deferred outbound work.

entries.name: OutboxStore
entries.summary: ABC for OutboxEntry persistence backends.

entries.name: OutboxDrainService
entries.summary: Service that drains the outbox, retrying with backoff and DLQ.

entries.name: AbstractEventBus
entries.summary: ABC for cross-process event-bus adapters.

entries.name: on_event
entries.summary: Registers a function as a typed cross-process event handler.

entries.name: PermissionDef
entries.summary: Declarative permission definition: name, description, implies, sensitive.

entries.name: PermissionRegistry
entries.summary: Registry of PermissionDef objects with collision detection.

entries.name: has_permission
entries.summary: Resolves whether a session/user/role holds a permission, walking implies.
